item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: Too Many Agencies Involved In Doctor Workforce Pipeline: Health DG
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
DG Mahathar says the doctor workforce pipeline is fragmented across MOHE, JPA, and MOH, causing delays and staff shortages despite adequate workforce numbers. He wants end-to-end workforce planning, competency-based approaches, and less "regulatory drag". item.title: Beyond Maternal Health: Rethinking Women’s Health Policy
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia has built strong foundations in maternal and reproductive health. The next step is to build on those foundations. This includes linking prevention, screening, and long-term management of chronic conditions alongside reproductive health services.
